name: Marimo
description: A reactive Python notebook in your workspace. Open it from the Apps grid and start writing cells — change one and everything that depends on it re-runs by itself, so a notebook can never show a stale result. Notebooks are plain .py files kept on the workspace disk, so they survive restarts, updates and reinstalls, and nothing is exposed outside the workspace.

volumes.reason: Everything the user owns: the notebooks themselves under /data/notebooks (plain .py files) and Marimo's own user config — theme, keymap, AI settings — under /data/home. Without it every container recreation (app update, workspace redeploy, reinstall) loses every notebook that was ever written.

skills.description: Where this workspace's Marimo notebooks live on disk, how to open the app, what does and does not survive a container recreate, and the two settings that must never be flipped on it.

auto_start.title: Auto-start
auto_start.description: Start Marimo automatically when the workspace starts.

apps.reason: This app ships a static mcp.json (the 'marimo' server) that MCP Gateway discovers and merges; without the gateway no agent can reach its notebook tools.

dependencies.note: Runtime-enforced app dependency: aw-workspace loads mcp-gateway before this app so the gateway can scan marimo/mcp.json.
